lyo.title: Freeze-drying
lyo.p1: Freeze-drying is a preservation technique that removes water from a product by sublimation. It preserves the nutritional qualities, taste, and texture of fresh fruit.
lyo.p2: Unlike traditional techniques such as heat drying, freeze-drying is done at low temperature, keeping up to 97% of the vitamins and minerals found in fresh fruit.
lyo.p3: The result? Ultra-crunchy fruits, naturally sweet, light and easy to store, while keeping their intense flavor and nutritional benefits.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.p1: At CrunchyVita, we believe snacking can be both delicious and healthy. Our mission is to offer 100% natural snacks, with no added sugar or preservatives, made from quality fresh fruit.
mission.p2: We select our fruits carefully from certified organic farms to bring you the best of nature in every pouch.

collected.p2: In addition, as you browse, we collect information about:

ShippingPolicy.title: Shipping Policy

preparation.title: Preparation and dispatch
preparation.p1: Packages are prepared and shipped within 48 hours of the order (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays). Once the package is handed to the carrier, you receive a confirmation email with the tracking number.
preparation.p2: During high-activity periods, the preparation time may be extended to 72 hours. Delivery is handled by Mondial Relay, delivering orders to the customer's home, workplace, or a pickup point.

absence.title: In case of absence
absence.p1: If the customer is absent at the time of delivery, a delivery notice will be left and the carrier will contact them.
absence.p2: The customer can also leave specific instructions for the courier. If the parcel is not collected within the allotted time, it will be returned to our warehouse.

missingInfo.title: Missing information or incomplete details
missingInfo.p1: The customer must provide all information necessary for proper delivery (exact address, phone number, access code, etc.).
missingInfo.p2: If this information is missing, our company will not be liable for delivery failure. Products will be returned to our warehouse and the customer must contact customer service to arrange a new delivery, which will be billed to the customer.

issues.title: Delivery issues
issues.p1: Products travel at our company's risk, except in special cases.
issues.p2: The customer must check the package condition and the number of products upon receipt. Any reservation (damage, missing product, damaged packaging) must be noted on the delivery slip, which the customer must keep a copy of.
issues.p3: Any complaint regarding delivery must be made within 3 working days after receipt of the products, by email to:

ShippingPolicy.promo: Free delivery in France to Chronopost pickup points from 40 EUR of purchases!

returnSection.title: Returns
returnSection.p1: With our company, the customer may return the product(s) concerned (in their original condition and accompanied by all commercial documents included with the delivery).
returnSection.p2: Return shipping costs are borne by the customer, except when a product has a manufacturing defect or does not match the original order. Only the price of the returned product(s) will be refunded. The refund will be made as soon as possible and no later than 14 days after receipt of the products by our company, using the payment method chosen at purchase.
returnSection.p3: The right of withdrawal may be exercised from the time the order is placed, after the customer has received delivery of the products. The criteria are based on the original condition and a state that allows resale. The company reserves the right to refuse products that do not meet these return conditions and to send them back to the customer.

procedure.intro: To ensure optimal processing of your return, please follow the procedure below:

step1.title: 1. Contact customer service by email at contact@crunchyvita.com
step1.body: specifying the invoice number and the products concerned.

step2.title: 2. Prepare the products concerned

step3.title: 3. Return the parcel to the following address:
step3.address: ALTEORA, 1460 Chemin des Terriers Building B-04 06600 Antibes.
step3.note: The parcel must be dropped off at a post office within 14 days from the date of return authorization.

procedure.outro: Upon receipt of your parcel, our quality service will verify the integrity of the return and the acceptance conditions. If the conditions are met, we will proceed with a refund or replacement and send the products within 3 to 5 working days from the time your return is taken in charge by our warehouse.

refund.title: Refund
refund.p1: Refunds are issued according to the payment method and currency used at purchase.
refund.p2: We will refund your returned item as soon as possible after its receipt. The credit to your bank account will be effective within 7 to 10 working days.
